events.title: iPhone 14 released
events.summary: Apple began selling the iPhone 14 on September 16, 2022 — satellite emergency SOS and crash detection on Pro models, USB standards pressure building.
events.about: The 14 Pro introduced Dynamic Island — a live activity surface developers could target for persistent status UI. Emergency satellite features showed phones as safety devices beyond apps.

narrative.whyChosen: The iPhone 14 Pro's Dynamic Island created a new live UI surface for developers.
narrative.whyImportant: Dynamic Island APIs extended how apps show ongoing status around the camera cutout.
narrative.problemSolved: Persistent status UI was trapped in notifications or in-app chrome.
